note: Creatures of the realms (roadmap item 58, first part; core/game/game_realms.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). Every creature belongs to a realm: `of` names the ones that are not of the home realm (`settings.home`), and a creature that is not listed is of home. A creature of another realm is rarer at home and sells for `foreign_value_mult` there. THE REST IS WRITTEN BUT SWITCHED OFF (`settings.linked` is false) until the worlds are joined by gates (item 41 and the sandbox): a kept creature can be taken to another realm (`in_realm`); until it has lived there `adapt_years` of that realm it is unsettled (`unsettled`: it costs more to keep and sours faster), unless that realm is one of its own; home, where every kept creature was found or born, never needs adapting to. Young of parents of two different realms carry both (`realms`) and take the mark of each world (`marks`, at most `max_marks`). A mark changes the same numbers a trait does. The mark of an unstable realm (the Void, the Dreaming) is unstable: each year it is awake with `awake_chance`, rolled on dice keyed on the dynasty seed, the year, the creature and the mark, never the dynasty's; while dormant it does nothing.
